newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' 1997 Q1 GNP growth rate 6.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' 1997 Q1 GNP growth rate 6.1 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' first quarter real gross national product (GNP) grew 6.1 percent against a revised 6.9 percent a year earlier, Planning Secretary Cielito Habito said on Thursday.
The gross domestic product (GDP) rose 5.0 percent from a revised 5.1 percent in the same period last year.
A recent Reuter poll showed that brokerage houses were expecting the GNP to grow by an average 6.34 percent, and GDP at 5.16 percent.
"As expected, it is the service and agriculture sector which fuelled the economic growth in the supply side...it is within expectations," Habito said.
He said he remained confident GNP growth this year would meet the government's 7-8 percent target.
